findings.detail: trust.toml has at least one pinned peer. Removing a pin or lowering its role closes that peer's established connections. It applies to new connections from the next handshake, and to connections held open by a running `qsh serve`, `qsh listen` or `qsh serve --to` within 2 seconds. It applies on this device only; no other device is told. It does not end sessions: a session on a closed connection is detached, and a peer that is still trusted can reconnect and resume it.
findings.remedy: Trust is withdrawn per device: run the same `qsh trust remove` (or `qsh trust set-role`) on every other device that trusts the peer. To end the peer's sessions as well, close them with `qsh session close`.
